problem_type: Conflicting planner instructions and model-facing contracts
symptom: C0 omitted operation, translated an explicitly preserved title and omitted requested generation settings.
direct_cause: The loaded skill taught the obsolete operation-free tool alias and mandated English while the shared schema requires operation and the user required the original title.
class_root: Planner instruction entry points did not agree with the shared language and model-facing contract owners.
affected_population: Every model using the bundled storyboard skill or JSON planner
internal_only_reason: Internal prompt and schema agreement; no external protocol or SDK API is changed.
invariants: All planner instructions preserve user-authored fields and follow requested language.
The lane skill names the active tool and its required operation.
Optional catalog settings derive only when unspecified; explicit user choices must be retained.
generality_proof: Correct both discovered planner entry points and the shared tool descriptions without model-specific branches; inspect the actual loopback request and preserve native validation feedback.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Publish unambiguous operation and examples to all model profiles.
Preserve user fields regardless of interface language.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Native session line 3 embeds this exact obsolete English-only instruction.
Independent JSON planner also mandates English at line 72.

recurrence.reason: Bundled instructions are reused across users and models.
same_class_scan: rg English/英文/propose_storyboard_plan in skills/workbench-storyboard-planner and storyboardLauncher
Read canvasModelShapes optional settings and storyboardPlan.ts default materialization

prevention.invariant: Shared tool instructions identify required operation; planner prompts contain no competing output language mandate.
prevention.failure_mode: Missing operation remains an AJV error; the native retry channel is retained. Prompt compliance remains model-evaluated.
prevention.strategy: Remove obsolete alias and English mandate in both entry points, clarify shared schema descriptions and preserve authored fields.

legacy_paths.rationale: Obsolete instructions are replaced in place; no parallel implementation or stored data migration.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No SDK behavior is changed; native AJV rejection and retry already work.

migration: Reload bundled skill on next request; do not translate or rewrite existing project data.
residual_risks: Loopback proves request assembly and validation, not real-model instruction following. Third-round model comparison remains unrun under no-paid-model instruction.

invariant_owner_layer.why: Tool descriptions and schemas are shared across lane and MCP; tests inspect the actual lane wire request.
